projects.title: Here's the secret: no code
projects.big_idea: The 190-H3 closer made true: the Hobo Bag is half price right now, there is no code to hunt for, the matching pouch wallet comes with it, and the sale really ends on 30 November.
projects.why_new: Our first closer: a 30 s offer video built on the account's biggest ad, with its 'here's the secret' beat turned into a true one (no code, the wallet included) and a proof shot of the hidden back pocket that 190 never shows.

chapters.text: This is the Hobo Bag, and right now it's half price in the Early Black Friday sale.
Here's the secret. There's no code to find. The half price is already on the page, and the matching pouch wallet comes with the bag.
Your cards go in the hidden back pocket, flat against you. Your keys and phone go in the gold side zips.
It's fifty percent off with free shipping, and the sale ends on the thirtieth of November. Tap the link below.
